issues.description: The script uses @grant unsafeWindow, which exposes privileged script context to the page and can be abused if not handled carefully.
issues.recommendation: Remove unsafeWindow unless strictly necessary. If used, ensure all interactions are strictly controlled and sanitized.

issues.description: The script requests GM_openInTab and GM.openInTab permissions, which can be abused to open arbitrary tabs.
issues.recommendation: Remove these permissions if not strictly required, or ensure their use is limited to user-initiated actions.

issues.description: The script uses @require to load three external scripts from update.greasyfork.org. These URLs are not version-pinned with a hash and could be replaced upstream, introducing supply chain risk.
issues.recommendation: Pin @require URLs to a specific version or hash, and only use trusted sources.

script_name: 🏆 [#1 Chess Assistant] A.C.A.S (Advanced Chess Assistance System)
summary: The script does not directly transmit user data to third-party servers, nor does it collect sensitive information or use obfuscation. However, it requests high-privilege grants (unsafeWindow, GM_openInTab) and loads external dependencies without version pinning, introducing supply chain and privilege escalation risks. No DOM XSS, privacy collection, or WebSocket usage detected in the provided code. Review of the required external scripts is necessary for a complete assessment.
